product_overview: FreeInference Proxy Dashboard is a localhost read-only operations console for monitoring concurrent proxy activity. It helps operators review live request activity, aggregate request counts, API keys, and recent request details in a single dashboard.
core_goals: Open the dashboard and view the FreeInference Proxy operational overview
Check aggregate request activity through the total request count
Inspect recent proxied requests with method, path, status, and latency details
Review the configured API keys section
Watch new requests appear in the dashboard in real time without reloading

features.name: Dashboard Home
features.description: Displays the main FreeInference Proxy dashboard layout and title for operator monitoring.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> See the FreeInference Proxy dashboard title and layout

features.name: Request Statistics
features.description: Shows the aggregate total number of proxied requests on the dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View the total requests metric

features.name: Recent Requests Table
features.description: Lists recent proxied requests with request metadata for quick inspection.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View the recent requests table -> See rows showing request method, path, status, and latency

features.name: API Keys Section
features.description: Displays the configured API keys management section on the dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View the API keys section

features.name: Live Request Updates
features.description: Updates the recent requests table in real time as new proxied requests arrive.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Keep the dashboard open -> Observe new requests appear in the recent requests table without reloading

tech_stack.other: server-sent events (SSE) for realtime request updates

routes.description: Recent proxied request history as JSON

features.name: Dashboard Loads
